I'm a Software Engineer with the passion and taste for crafting precise, high-quality solutions.

bio: Eddie is a Software Developer with a keen eye for detail and a passion for creating high-quality, efficient solutions. He holds a Bachelor of Advanced Computing (Software Development) from the University of Sydney, where he wrote his thesis on *“Portal Redirection in Virtual Reality using Impossible Spaces”*.

At SSW he works on projects that use AI to supercharge existing applications, and headless CMS to streamline content management. His focus is on delivering solutions that precisely meet client requirements.
